total = 0
for p in paths:
    s = repo.read(p)
    n_nl = s.count("\n")
    ends_nl = s.endswith("\n")
    lines = n_nl if (ends_nl or s == "") else n_nl + 1
    out[p] = {"newlines": n_nl, "ends_with_newline": ends_nl, "lines": lines, "bytes": len(s)}
    total += lines
result({"files": out, "total": total})
